descriptions.text: Quadruped weapon mount. “The scorpion’s bite.” Non-magical bandolier accessory. Allows for the mounting of multiple ranged weapons. May fire and load via inventory action.

recap.text: Donut stalks a circle round Huanxin, whose shields she has clawed away, while Eileithyia cannot move until Katia makes her choice. A non-magical quadruped weapon mount, the scorpion's bite, appears on Donut's back from the Apothecary's gold benefactor box. Katia's crossbow forms on it with an ominous click, bigger than Donut and not loaded, and Donut holds the weight just fine. Katia says it is weaker than it could be because she has no women in her party.

Donut zaps in on her back-mounted Scorpion's Bite with the crossbow cocked, and Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus buries itself in Emberus's smoldering eye socket. A second shot, one of her ten Danforth bolts, enters the other eye to hold the god in place.

beats.headline: A gift with an implication
beats.text: In Eileithyia's tent, Donut stalks a circle round Huanxin, whose shields she has just clawed away, while the goddess cannot move until Katia makes her choice. A strange device appears on Donut's back, from the gold benefactor box she received from the Apothecary: a simple gift, Carl thinks, but the implication is clear. A non-magical quadruped weapon mount, the scorpion's bite. Katia's crossbow forms on it with an ominous click, bigger than Donut and not loaded, and she holds the weight just fine. It is not as strong as it could be, she says, because she has no women in her party.
beats.gist: Donut claws away Huanxin's shields, then receives a scorpion-bite weapon mount that holds Katia's crossbow.

beats.headline: A bolt for the driver
beats.text: On the starting line, Donut's target is Rapture, the womantaur driver. Her weapon mount forms on her back with Katia's crossbow, and a glowing Danforth bolt locks into place on its own; they have only ten and hope to get this one back. The plan: when the light turns green, Carl breaks the window, Donut roots the driver in place with the bolt, and Chiyome's giant bear smashes the car aside, so that it moves out from under her.
beats.gist: Donut's weapon mount forms with Katia's crossbow, and she plans to root driver Rapture with a Danforth bolt.

beats.headline: Into the god's eye
beats.text: Emberus, sobbing, enraged and growing, rears back with a flaming ball in his hand. Donut zaps into the room through one of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps with the Scorpion's Bite on her back and the crossbow cocked and ready. Loaded into it is Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus. Donut aims, and she fires true: the bolt buries itself in Emberus's smoldering eye socket. A second shot enters the other eye, one of her ten Danforth bolts, designed to hold the god in place.
beats.gist: Donut shoots Emberus in both eyes: Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus, then a Danforth bolt.
